'''GeneTech Syndicate''' was a biotechnology company present in the [[Corellian system/Legends|Corellian system]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Description==
{{Quote|We've filed a complaint with the Imperial Research Division for carrying out class 5 biological experiments on an inhabited world, but I think it's going to be a long time before we see anything come of that.|Agent Taarna, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:G" />}}
[[File:GeneTech_Syndicate_Lab.jpg|thumb|right|200px|The [[GeneTech Syndicate Lab]] on [[Talus/Legends|Talus]].]]
The GeneTech Syndicate was present on [[Talus/Legends|Talus]] during the Galactic Civil War. It was known known to have an intermittent business relationship with the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. The company owned a [[GeneTech Syndicate Lab|laboratory]], located just outside the city of [[Dearic/Legends|Dearic]]. Although it was listed as engaging in legitimate genetic manipulation on animals, the GeneTech Syndicate used this lab to conduct illegal experiments.<ref name="SWG:G" />

==History==
{{Quote|Now that you have confirmed this as the site of the original experiment, we can conclude the queen might still be here. I need you to do a few things for me first; you must destroy all information regarding project 'Parasophic Arachne', you must destroy any of the eggs that you find, and you must kill all the creatures in the lab.|Agent Taarna, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:G" />}}
By the time of the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the GeneTech Syndicate conducted an illegal and dangerous [[Bioengineering/Legends|bioengineering]] project in its Talusian lab. Dubbed [[Parasophic Arachne]] program, the objective was to create an intelligent and powerful form of [[arachne]]s for the use of the Empire.<ref name="SWG:G" /> The project was led by [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Vigh]], the [[Chief Scientist/Legends|chief scientist]] of the GeneTech Syndicate.<ref name="GP">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=66911&resource=features|text=Genetic Potential}}</ref>

[[File:Arachne_Queen.jpg|thumb|left|200px|The Arachne queen.]]
The scientists of the Parasophic Arachne successfully managed to bioengineer deadly and intelligent creatures.<ref name="SWG:GD">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|Grim Discovery|Talus}}</ref> Doctor Vigh thus ordered to transport several specimens to the [[Imperial research facility (Nubia)|Imperial research facility]] on [[Nubia/Legends|Nubia]]. However, the transport carrying the creatures crashed in the Talusian mountains near the city of [[Nashal]] just after its departure.<ref name="GP" /> Moreover, the arachnes in the lab escaped containment and overwhelmed their creators, slaughtering most of the staff of the GeneTech Syndicate Lab. All the surviving scientists quickly fled and went into hiding to avoid being charged with illegal biological experiments by the [[Corellian Security Force|CorSec]].<ref name="SWG:G" /> [[Jana T'bayr]] was the sole scientist to remain in the lab. She initially wanted to save the project but she then tried to find a way to prevent the parasophic arachnes from destroying the planet Talus.<ref name="SWG:AB">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|Adaptive Biology|Talus}}</ref>

[[File:Arachne_crash_site.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Arachnes around the crashed ship.]]
The Parasophic Arachne program was exposed after the ship carrying engineered arachnes crashed in the mountains near Nashal,<ref name="SWG:RO">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|Rescue Operation|Talus}}</ref> in [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]].<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> CorSec [[Agent/Legends|Agent]] [[Taarna]] dispatched a spacer to investigate the crash site and rescue any survivors.<ref name="SWG:RO" /> However, the spacer discovered that [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Narl (captain)|Narl]] and all the other survivors were killed while trying to prevent the arachnes from escaping in the wilderness.<ref name="SWG:GD" />

[[File:AdaptiveBiology-GH.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Spacers discovering the queen's mate in the lab.]]

The CorSec later traced the flight trajectory of the crashed ship and found that it took off from Dearic. A CorSec [[Scout/Legends|scout]] team then discovered that the GeneTech Syndicate Lab was undergoing an emergency evacuation.<ref name="SWG:G" /> Agent Taarna recruited spacers who headed to the lab and discovered that the building was completely overwhelmed by the bioengineered creatures. The spacers first located the directory terminal and downloaded evidences and details about the project known as Parasophic Arachne.<ref name="SWG:G" /> Taarna therefore ordered his CorSec crew to clear the lab.<ref name="SWG:AB">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|Adaptive Biology|Talus}}</ref> With the help of [[6-POC]], the project manager's [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]], the spacers managed to delete all scientific data that could be used to restart the program.<ref name="SWG:ABLTG">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=other}}Legacy Quest: "A Better Life Through Genetics" on Talus</ref> They also retrieved a self-destruct intron virus, a virus designed specifically by the GeneTech Syndicate scientists to kill the arachnes. The spacers applied this virus to every arachne [[Egg/Legends|eggs]] they found in the lab.<ref name="SWG:FtS">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|Find the Source|Talus}}</ref> The CorSec crew later eliminated the arachne queen, the huge arachne responsible for breeding the parasophic arachne species.<ref name="SWG:G" /> Eventually, the spacers destroyed the queen's mate, the largest and strongest bioengineered arachne.<ref name="SWG:AB" /> The destruction of all the breeding arachnes and eggs definitely eliminated the Parasophic Arachne threat.<ref name="SWG:G" />

After the planet Talus was saved from the bioenineered arachnes, the CorSec targeted the escaped Genetech Syndicate scientists. The CorSec also filed a complaint with the [[Imperial Research Division]] against the GeneTech Syndicate for carrying out class 5 biological experiments on an inhabited world. Nevertheless, Agent Taarna was very pessimistic about the chances of success of this investigation.<ref name="SWG:G" />

==Behind the scenes==
The GeneTech Syndicate appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Roleplaying game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:G" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The GeneTech Syndicate was added to the game as part of the "[[W:c:swg:Genocide|Deifying Decisions]]" arcs with the release of "[[W:c:swg:Chapter 2|Chapter 2: The Talus Incident]]," on [[August 1]], [[2006]].<ref name="SonyForumsCite-Chapter 2: The Talus Incident Publish Notes, August 1st">{{SonyForumsCite|full_url=http://soe.lithium.com/swg/board/message?board.id=DevDiscussion&message.id=58871|text="Chapter 2: The Talus Incident" Publish Notes, August 1st}}</ref>
